source: docs/design/design-system.md (Runloop Signature v1), apps/studio/src/app/tokens.css (dark theme), apps/studio/src/town/townPalette.ts and sky.ts (the 3-D town's own colours), plus the founder brief of 2026-10-18 and the founder's decisions for this film. Gathered by hand: the Studio is being reworked, so gather.mjs was not run.

identityHues.note: Agent identity hues never signal state; lime is never an identity hue. The film's agent HQ band uses id1 (the hue the fixture and the screenshots give 'Engineering House').

town.note: The product's own 3-D town colours (townPalette.ts). Lime never appears in town materials (CIEDE2000 >= 12). Only state glows.

film.note: The film's night grade. Every value is the product's own night (sky.ts NIGHT_SKY, GLOW) except 'void', a deeper midnight for the frame edges and the opening darkness.

colourRules: Real-agent events in 3-D are LIME #B8F36A (founder decision 2026-10-18; replaces the brief's cyan). Lime marks only what a real Claude Code session reported: the HQ beacon while live and working, event pulses, the trail from a building element to a trace row.
Amber (#FFD18A windows, #FFD89A lamps) belongs to the simulated town's life: lit windows where residents are home or at work, street lamps at night.
Failure #FF6B76 only for a recorded failure (the exit-1 node --test); warning #F5B84B only for a recorded permission wait.
Ice #E8EBF0 is the neutral light: type, the replay playhead, the road-network trace that becomes the logo.
No cyan, no neon, no glow on UI chrome. Bloom only on emissive state (windows, lamps, beacon, event pulses).

display3d.use: TTFLoader / text3D only: a variable TTF loads at its default 400 instance

fonts.missingGlyphs: Neither face has U+25C7 (the Studio's 'Simulated' diamond), U+2713 (check) or U+23F8 (pause). Draw them as shapes, never as text. Both faces have · × → ← — – … ▶.

wordmark.mark: assets/logo-mark.svg (Studio BrandRing: path 'M12 3a9 9 0 1 1-8.5 6', stroke 2.4 round, dot r 2.1 at 5.2,5.6, in lime on a slate tile)
wordmark.style: Geist 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, Ice on Obsidian; the Studio sets 'Studio' after it in Muted 500 (not used in the film)

decisions.realCapture: one real Claude Code Haiku session (<= $0.10), captured after the Studio's immersive rework is final; not part of this pass
